We construct TemporalBench through a unified dataset transformation pipeline designed to ensure methodological consistency, reproducibility, and comparability across heterogeneous time-series domains.

evidence.quote: temporal tasks, we design a lightweight feature extraction and visualization module and integrate it into a representative general agent, AgentScope with gpt-4o as the backbone.

The proposed module augments raw time-series input with two complementary representations. First, we extract a compact set of structured numerical features summarizing global statistics and multi-scale temporal dynamics.
Second, we generate a visualization of the time series as an additional modality, exposing relative changes, peaks, and structural patterns that are difficult to infer from raw numeric tokens alone.

reconciliation.reason: The packet supports the existing resource-level event-boundary benchmark pipeline. Its event injection/detection and historical/future partitioning are temporal GTS mechanisms, and its rule-based labels explicitly avoid context leakage. The old control/verification label does not describe in-episode agent execution control; the source-defined interface is the task input/output and access design.
